description: This Java source file defines the 'ExecutionPool' class, which manages various thread pools, scheduled executors, and delay queues for concurrent task execution within the OFBiz framework. It includes thread factory customization, pulse scheduling, and utility methods for handling futures.

classes.name: ExecutionPool
classes.description: Final class providing thread pool management, scheduling, and a delay queue with associated worker threads for the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ExecutionPool.ExecutionPoolThreadFactory
classes.description: ThreadFactory implementation to create daemon threads with specific naming conventions.

classes.name: ExecutionPool.Pulse
classes.description: Abstract class representing a task scheduled to run after a delay, implementing Delayed and Runnable, with expiration and load time tracking.

classes.name: ExecutionPool.ExecutionPoolPulseWorker
classes.description: Runnable worker that continuously processes 'Pulse' tasks from the DelayQueue.

methods.name: getScheduledExecutor
methods.description: Creates and configures a ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor with options for thread timeout and pre-starting core threads.

methods.name: getAllFutures
methods.description: Collects results from a collection of Future objects, handling exceptions and logging errors.

methods.name: addPulse
methods.description: Adds a 'Pulse' task to the delay queue for future execution.

methods.name: removePulse
methods.description: Removes a 'Pulse' task from the delay queue if present.
